message: Cave (world 16, level 50): цепочка из трёх сайд-квестов у Торговца в пещере (NPC 31, bot 1087): медь и уголь -> аметистовые призмы -> сера и корни. Награды 250/450/900 золота и 200/400/800 опыта, все шаги с диалогами и задачами.

DialogData.text: Hoy there, <player>. Mind the drips - cave water eats through leather and patience alike.
I am the only trader for a mile of tunnels, and my shelves are bare. No copper, no coal, no business.
Bring me five chunks of copper ore and five of coal from the seams up top, and I will make it worth your while.
So you are the one who cleared my order. Reliable hands - and in this cave that is rarer than amethyst.
Speaking of amethyst: the prisms in the lower galleries have started to bloom. Pretty things, but they hum loud enough to crack a lamp.
Break twelve of them before the whole vein wakes up. I will pay well, and I will pretend I did not see you pocket a shard.
Now the air has gone foul. Sulfur blightmaws are nesting in the vents and my lungs cannot take another week of it.
Eight of the beasts should thin them out, and I need vitriol roots for the salve - three will do.
Do that and you will have a friend in this cave. Friends are worth more than gold down here.
Copper, coal, amethyst - if it glitters in the dark, I sell it. Bring me ore and we will talk business.
